{{Top|leg}}
'''Vid-palaces''' were locations that showed vids.<ref name="Dawn">''[[Jedi Dawn]]''</ref>

One was located on [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]] at 182 Riverside.<ref name="Dawn" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
[[Havet Storm]] accepted an invitation to visit one during his time on the planet. At the time it was scheduled to show an ancient horror vid. When he visited, it was used to show a recruiting message for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Dawn" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Vid-palaces appear in the choose your own adventure book ''[[Jedi Dawn]]'', written by [[Paul Cockburn]] and published in [[1993]].<ref name="Dawn" />

*''[[Jedi Dawn]]'' {{1st}}
